scope: Numbered source references explicitly printed in brackets or parentheses in installed Arabic Quran reader blocks, plus one separately identified Companion saying. A reference-key family is a locator, not a claim that all report variants are identical. Source passage types, unnumbered accounts, exact chain and full-variant selection remain pending.
limitations: Arabic text and native translations are omitted.
Some reader occurrences lack a verified original document paragraph; these remain explicitly unlinked.
Individual provider links use the documented API sequential-number syntax and stored archive row; remote responses were not individually fetched or checked in this audit.
Matching a number or normalized quotation does not establish narrator, chain or complete variant.

Public starter comparison checked the two Arabic hadith parents in the English essential 003 source envelope, not every report hidden in all 19 lesson envelopes; not-found means not identified in this finite check, not globally absent.
Only sixteen reader JSON links have independent recorded GitHub hash readback; other reader locations are identified by surah/mode/key in the recorded installed snapshot.
Quran verses and editorial explanations are not relabeled as hadith.
Model-assisted reference inventory; source-specific religious verification and publication conditions remain for review.
